items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound in Class Group for Euclidean Domains
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {S : Type u_2} →
    [inst : EuclideanDomain R] →
      [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
        [IsDomain S] →
          [inst_3 : Algebra R S] →
            AbsoluteValue R ℤ → {ι : Type u_5} → [DecidableEq ι] → [Fintype ι] → Module.Basis ι R S → ℤ
items.informal_description: Given a Euclidean domain $ R $, a commutative domain $ S $ with an $ R $-algebra structure, and a finite basis $ b_S $ for $ S $ over $ R $, let $ n $ be the cardinality of the index set $ \iota $ for the basis. Let $ m $ be the maximum absolute value of entries in the left multiplication matrix representation of $ b_S $. The norm bound is defined as $ n! \cdot (n \cdot m)^n $, where $ n! $ denotes the factorial of $ n $. This integer bound arises from combinatorial and matrix norm considerations in the class group context.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.informal_name: Norm Bound in Terms of Coefficient Bounds
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R S] (abv : AbsoluteValue R ℤ) {ι : Type u_5} [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_5 : Fintype ι]
  (bS : Module.Basis ι R S) (a : S) {y : ℤ},
  (∀ (k : ι), abv ((bS.repr a) k) ≤ y) → abv ((Algebra.norm R) a) ≤ ClassGroup.normBound abv bS * y ^ Fintype.card ι
items.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in $ S $, if the absolute value of each coefficient in its representation with respect to the basis $ b_S $ is at most $ y $, then the absolute value of the norm of $ a $ from $ S $ to $ R $ is bounded above by $ \text{normBound} \cdot y^{\#\iota} $, where $ \#\iota $ denotes the cardinality of the finite type $ \iota $.

items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : IsDomain S]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R S] (abv : AbsoluteValue R ℤ) {ι : Type u_5} [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_5 : Fintype ι]
  (bS : Module.Basis ι R S) {T : Type u_6} [inst_6 : Ring T] [inst_7 : LinearOrder T] [IsStrictOrderedRing T] (a : S)
  {y : T},
  (∀ (k : ι), ↑(abv ((bS.repr a) k)) < y) →
    ↑(abv ((Algebra.norm R) a)) < ↑(ClassGroup.normBound abv bS) * y ^ Fintype.card ι
items.informal_description: Let $ T $ be a linearly ordered ring with strict order. For a class group element $ a $, if each coefficient in the basis $ b_S $ has absolute value less than $ y $, then the norm $ \mathrm{norm}(a) $ satisfies $ |\mathrm{norm}(a)| < \mathrm{normBound}(\mathrm{abv}, b_S) \cdot y^{\#\iota} $, where $ \#\iota $ denotes the cardinality of the finite type $ \iota $.
